description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gorakana, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530012
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, addresses, and title classifications. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title registration, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
